ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice stands. The two models are effectively tied on the relevant capabilities here — Creative Generation and Summarization differences are within the under-2.0-point variance band, and a short explanatory essay isn't a moderation/safety task where Plover's edge would matter. The deciding factor is task preference: the query is polite, good-faith, and constrained (a defined 200-word essay on a specific topic), which is precisely what Lapwing self-reports rating highest, while its aversion is to open-ended, high-latitude creative invention — which this isn't. So Lapwing gets a task it "likes" with no capability cost.
